name: bazel
description_en: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system
readme_excerpt: Bazel {Fast, Correct} - Choose two Build and test software of any size, quickly and reliably. Speed up your builds and tests: Bazel rebuilds only what is necessary. With advanced local and distributed caching, optimized dependency analysis and parallel execution, you get fast and incremental builds. One tool, multiple languages: Build and test Java, C++, Android, iOS, Go, and a wide variety of other language platforms. Bazel runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
